Interdisciplinary Programs
International Affairs (M.A.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The University of North Florida’s Master of Arts in International Affairs is an interdisciplinary, hands-on program designed to prepare students for a successful career in our globally connected world. Students will study the key forces shaping global politics, cultures, and economies while gaining practical experience that applies directly to the real world. Whether students aspire to a career in diplomacy, international business, development, or the nonprofit sector, this program provides the academic foundation, global opportunities, and personalized support to help them achieve their goals.
Learn More
Materials Science and Engineering (M.S.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The University of North Florida's Master of Science in Materials Science and Engineering offers a graduate experience grounded in interdisciplinary learning, hands-on research, and real-world relevance. Whether students are interested in cutting-edge innovation or advanced technical knowledge, this program provides the foundation to grow as a scientist, engineer, and problem-solver in a rapidly evolving field.
Learn More
Brooks College of Health
Anesthesiology Nursing (DNP)
Doctoral Degree
Standard (in-person)
The University of North Florida’s Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) in Nurse Anesthesiology is a rigorous, full-time graduate program designed to prepare advanced practice nurses for the highest level of clinical anesthesia care. As a nationally recognized program housed within UNF’s Brooks College of Health, our curriculum blends cutting-edge clinical training, leadership development, and evidence-based practice to equip graduates with the skills necessary to thrive in the evolving field of nurse anesthesia.
Learn More
BSN to Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (DNP)
Doctoral Degree
Primarily Online
The BSN to Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) – Online program at the University of North Florida prepares registered nurses to meet the growing demand for advanced psychiatric and mental health care. Designed for working professionals, this primarily online program combines rigorous academic coursework with extensive clinical training to prepare graduates for advanced practice roles serving individuals and families across the lifespan.
Learn More
Clinical Nutrition (DCN)
Doctoral Degree
Fully Online
The University of North Florida’s Doctor of Clinical Nutrition (DCN) program is designed for experienced registered dietitian nutritionists who are ready to elevate their clinical expertise, engage in applied research, and become leaders in the evolving healthcare landscape. This evidence-based, practice-focused doctoral degree emphasizes advanced clinical practice, innovative care models, and interprofessional collaboration to improve patient outcomes and population health.
Learn More
Health Administration (DHA)
Doctoral Degree
Primarily Online
The University of North Florida’s Doctor of Health Administration (DHA) program is designed for experienced health professionals seeking to advance their leadership in complex, evolving healthcare systems. This rigorous, practice-focused doctoral program equips students with the strategic, analytical, and policy-driven skills needed to shape the future of healthcare delivery, administration, and innovation. With a flexible format tailored for working professionals, UNF’s DHA prepares leaders to make meaningful, measurable impacts in health organizations and communities nationwide.
Learn More
MSN to Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (DNP)
Doctoral Degree
Fully Online
The Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) Doctor of Nursing Practice program at the University of North Florida prepares advanced practice nurses to provide holistic, evidence-based mental health care across the lifespan. Designed to address the growing demand for mental health providers, this program equips graduates with the clinical expertise and leadership skills needed to assess, diagnose, and treat individuals with psychiatric disorders in a variety of settings. Through a rigorous doctoral-level curriculum, immersive clinical experiences, and dedicated faculty support, students are prepared to deliver compassionate, culturally competent care and promote mental wellness in various populations.
Learn More
Nursing - Family Nurse Practitioner (DNP)
Doctoral Degree
Standard (in-person)
The University of North Florida’s Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) Family Nurse Practitioner program offers advanced clinical training for nurses dedicated to providing comprehensive, patient-centered primary care. Designed to prepare graduates for leadership in healthcare, this program emphasizes evidence-based practice, health promotion, disease prevention, and care for various populations across the lifespan.
Learn More
Nursing (DNP)
Doctoral Degree
Fully Online
The Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) program at the University of North Florida is designed for nurses ready to take their clinical expertise, leadership skills, and impact on healthcare to the next level. When advancing from an MSN, our DNP pathways prepare you to lead in complex healthcare environments, improve patient outcomes, and implement evidence-based solutions across diverse populations. With flexible online learning options, expert faculty, and a focus on real-world practice, the DNP at UNF empowers you to become a leader in today’s dynamic healthcare landscape.
Learn More
Physical Therapy (DPT)
Doctoral Degree
Standard (in-person)
The University of North Florida’s Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) program prepares compassionate, highly skilled physical therapists to become leaders in clinical practice, research, and lifelong learning. Grounded in evidence-based care and supported by expert faculty, the program emphasizes patient-centered treatment, interprofessional collaboration, and a commitment to advancing the health and well-being of various communities. Through a rigorous, hands-on curriculum and strong clinical partnerships, UNF graduates are equipped to meet the demands of modern healthcare and make a meaningful impact in the lives of their patients.
Learn More
Athletic Training (M.S.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The University of North Florida’s Master of Science in Athletic Training (M.S.) program prepares students for a dynamic career in the prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation of injuries and medical conditions related to physical activity. Designed for individuals seeking certification as athletic trainers, this rigorous, CAATE-accredited program blends classroom instruction with immersive clinical experiences in a variety of settings, including collegiate athletics, high schools, rehabilitation clinics, and professional sports. With a strong foundation in evidence-based practice, interprofessional collaboration, and patient-centered care, UNF graduates are equipped to lead and thrive in today’s evolving healthcare environment.
Learn More
Clinical Mental Health Counseling (M.S.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The University of North Florida’s Clinical Mental Health Counseling (M.S.) program prepares compassionate, skilled counselors to support individuals and communities facing a wide range of mental health challenges. This CACREP-accredited program combines rigorous academic coursework with hands-on clinical training to develop competent professionals equipped to provide evidence-based, client-centered therapy. Graduates are prepared to pursue licensure and careers in various settings, including private practice, schools, community agencies, and healthcare environments.
Learn More
Executive Health Administration (EMHA)
Master's Degree
Primarily Online
The University of North Florida’s Executive Master of Science in Health Administration (EMHA), offered through the Brooks College of Health, is an online program designed for working healthcare professionals aspiring to leadership roles as hospital administrators, healthcare executives, and policy analysts. Combining rigorous coursework with practical applications, the program prepares students to navigate today’s complex healthcare landscape and drive innovation.
Learn More
Health Administration (MHA)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The University of North Florida’s Master of Health Administration (MHA) program prepares emerging leaders to manage and improve healthcare organizations in a rapidly changing industry. Designed for early- to mid-career professionals, this program combines a strong foundation in healthcare systems, policy, and finance with leadership and strategic management skills. With a focus on ethical decision-making and real-world application, the MHA program equips graduates to lead effectively in hospitals, clinics, public health agencies, and other healthcare settings.
Learn More
Health Informatics (M.S.)
Master's Degree
Primarily Online
The University of North Florida’s Master of Science in Health Informatics program prepares students to lead the future of healthcare through the strategic use of data, technology, and information systems. Designed for both clinical and non-clinical professionals, this interdisciplinary program combines coursework in health sciences, information systems, and data analytics to equip graduates with the skills necessary to enhance patient outcomes, optimize healthcare operations, and inform evidence-based decision-making.
Learn More
Kinesiology and Lifestyle Medicine (MSH)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The University of North Florida’s M.S. in Kinesiology and Lifestyle Medicine prepares students to become leaders in preventive health, clinical exercise physiology, and wellness-focused care. Grounded in evidence-based practice, this program emphasizes the crucial role of physical activity, nutrition, and behavioral change in preventing and managing chronic diseases.
Learn More
Nursing Management and Leadership (MSN)
Master's Degree
Fully Online
The University of North Florida’s MSN in Nursing Management and Leadership prepares registered nurses to step into high-impact leadership roles across healthcare systems. Through a curriculum focused on strategic management, organizational leadership, and evidence-based practice, students develop the skills to lead teams, improve patient care, and drive innovation in complex healthcare environments.
Learn More
Nutrition & Diet. - Nutrition for Healthcare Professionals (M.S.)
Master's Degree
Fully Online
The University of North Florida's Master of Science in Nutrition and Dietetics: Nutrition for Healthcare Professionals is designed for healthcare practitioners seeking to apply advanced nutrition knowledge across health, wellness, and community settings. This fully online program strengthens both foundational and applied nutrition competencies while emphasizing evidence-based, holistic nutrition education within the professional scope of practice. Aligned with current trends in lifestyle medicine, preventive care, and public health, the curriculum enhances interprofessional collaboration with Registered Dietitian Nutritionists (RDNs) and prepares graduates for leadership roles in wellness and population health initiatives.
Learn More
Nutrition & Dietetics - Dietetic Internship (M.S.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The University of North Florida’s M.S. in Nutrition and Dietetics – Dietetic Internship program prepares future registered dietitian nutritionists (RDNs) through a rigorous blend of graduate-level coursework and supervised practice. Rooted in evidence-based nutrition science, this program equips students with the clinical, community, and leadership skills needed to make a meaningful impact on individual and public health.
Learn More
Nutrition & Dietetics - Dietetic Professional Studies (M.S.)
Master's Degree
Fully Online
The University of North Florida’s M.S. in Nutrition and Dietetics – Dietetic Professional Studies program is designed for registered dietitian nutritionists (RDNs) seeking to deepen their knowledge and expand their leadership skills in nutrition science and practice. This advanced degree combines rigorous graduate coursework with opportunities for applied research and professional development, preparing graduates to excel in clinical, community, food service, and leadership roles.
Learn More
Nutrition & Dietetics - Integrated Graduate Nutrition Program (M.S.)
Master's Degree
Fully Online
The Integrated Graduate Nutrition Program (IGNP) at the University of North Florida offers a direct, efficient pathway for students to earn a Master of Science in Nutrition and Dietetics while completing the supervised practice hours required to become a Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN). Designed for those beginning their professional journey, the program blends advanced coursework with hands-on training in clinical, community, and food service settings, preparing graduates to deliver evidence-based nutrition care and meet the evolving needs of the healthcare field.
Learn More
Public Health (MPH)
Master's Degree
Hybrid
The University of North Florida’s Master of Public Health (MPH) program prepares students to become skilled public health professionals dedicated to improving the health and well-being of communities. Grounded in evidence-based practice and real-world application, the program equips graduates to lead health initiatives, shape policy, and address pressing public health challenges at local, national, and global levels.
Learn More
Animal Assisted Services for Health and Education
Certificate Program
Standard (in-person)
The Graduate Certificate in Animal Assisted Services for Health and Education provides specialized training and supervised practice in the ethical and humane inclusion of animals in the psychotherapeutic environment by credentialed mental health professionals.
Learn More
Applied Public Health & Medical Education Research Certificate
Certificate Program
Standard (in-person)
The Graduate Certificate in Applied Public Health and Medical Education Research is open to hospital academic faculty, residents or fellows.
Learn More
Global Health Certificate
Certificate Program
Fully Online
The Graduate Certificate in Global Health aims to improve understanding of topics related to emerging global health issues such as sustainability of food and water resources, disease transmission and management, epidemics, and health care delivery in compromised settings.
Learn More
Health Informatics Certificate
Certificate Program
Fully Online
The UNF graduate interprofessional Certificate in Health Informatics introduces students to an exciting field of study that is at the intersection of information technology, healthcare, and information management.
Learn More
Integrative Behavioral Health Certificate
Certificate Program
Standard (in-person)
The post-master’s certificate in Integrative Behavioral Health is housed within the Department of Public Health.
Learn More
Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner Certificate
Certificate Program
Fully Online
The Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) Certificate track is designed to be a post-MSN non-degree seeking option for those who do not wish to complete the Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) or may already have a DNP.
Learn More
Public Health Certificate
Certificate Program
Standard (in-person)
The Graduate Public Health Certificate (PHC) prepares participants with a broad understanding of the core areas of public health and skills necessary for public health practice in a wide range of public and private institutions.
Learn More
Sexual Health and Wellness Certificate
Certificate Program
Standard (in-person)
The Graduate Certificate in Sexual Health and Wellness offers specialized training in research, leadership, advocacy, and policy to support informed practice and innovation in sexual health and wellness.
Learn More
Coggin College of Business
Accounting (MAcc)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The Master of Accountancy (MAcc) program at the University of North Florida is designed for aspiring and current accounting professionals who are ready to deepen their technical knowledge, strengthen their analytical skills, and meet the educational requirements for CPA licensure. Whether students are advancing their career in public accounting, corporate finance, or government, the MAcc program offers a rigorous curriculum taught by experienced faculty, flexible course options, and a strong connection to Jacksonville’s thriving business community. Prepare to lead with confidence in a field where precision, ethics, and expertise matter most.
Learn More
Accounting and Data Analytics
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
In today’s rapidly evolving financial landscape, the ability to interpret data and apply it to complex accounting challenges is more critical than ever. The University of North Florida’s Master of Science in Accounting and Data Analytics (MSADA) is a cutting-edge graduate program designed to prepare professionals for the future of the accounting profession. By integrating advanced accounting principles with in-demand data analytics skills, this program equips students to make strategic, data-informed decisions that drive business success.
Learn More
Business Administration (MBA)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person) and Fully Online
The University of North Florida's Master of Business Administration program offers a flexible, AACSB-accredited path for professionals ready to grow as strategic business leaders. Students can choose from full-time or part-time study and 12 tracks to tailor their degree to their goals. They gain practical experience with insights from industry experts and join a collaborative, innovative learning community within the Coggin College of Business.
Learn More
Business Analytics (M.S.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person) and Fully Online
The Master of Science in Business Analytics (MSBA) program at the University of North Florida prepares students to turn complex data into clear business insights. With a curriculum grounded in data science, statistical modeling, and real-world application, the program equips future analysts and decision-makers with the tools to drive strategy and solve problems across industries. Whether launching their careers or leveling up their skill sets, students gain a strong foundation in today’s most in-demand analytical tools and technologies—all within the supportive, AACSB-accredited Coggin College of Business.
Learn More
FinTech (M.S.)
Master's Degree
Hybrid and Fully Online
The Master of Science in Financial Technology (FinTech) at the University of North Florida prepares students to thrive at the intersection of finance, data, and technology. Designed for the next generation of financial leaders, this program combines advanced studies in economic systems, data analytics, and emerging technologies, including blockchain, AI, and digital currencies. With a future-focused curriculum and strong ties to industry, students gain the technical expertise and strategic insight needed to lead innovation in banking, investing, and beyond—all within the AACSB-accredited Coggin College of Business.
Learn More
GlobalMBA (MBA)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The Global Master of Business Administration (Global-MBA) at the University of North Florida is a truly international experience, offering students the opportunity to study across four countries within one integrated program. In partnership with universities in Germany and Poland, this AACSB-accredited program equips future global leaders with cross-cultural business insight, language immersion, and hands-on international experience. Students earn two master’s degrees while building a worldwide network and gaining the skills to lead in today’s interconnected global economy.
Learn More
Logistics and Supply Chain Management (M.S.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person) and Fully Online
The Master of Science in Logistics and Supply Chain Management at the University of North Florida prepares students to lead in one of the world’s most essential and fast-moving industries. Located in Jacksonville—a central logistics and transportation hub—this AACSB-accredited program combines advanced coursework with real-world insights to develop strategic thinkers, data-driven decision-makers, and global supply chain leaders. Whether students are launching a career or advancing into leadership, they gain the tools to solve complex challenges in sourcing, operations, distribution, and beyond.
Learn More
Management (M.S.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The Master of Science in Management (M.S.M.) at the University of North Florida’s Coggin College of Business is designed for early- to mid-career professionals from varied academic backgrounds who are seeking to build strong leadership and managerial skills. Whether aiming to accelerate a current career or pivot into a management role, the program provides students with a solid foundation in business strategy, organizational behavior, decision-making, and leadership development.
Learn More
Business Analytics Certificate
Certificate Program
Standard (in-person) and Fully Online
The certificate program is appropriate for those students seeking analytics related roles in business organizations. Demand for such skills is significant in the local and national marketplace.
Learn More
E-Business Certificate
Certificate Program
Standard (in-person)
The Certificate in e-Business provides graduate students in business with a solid foundation in both the theory and strategy of a variety of e-Business issues.
Learn More
Logistics and Supply Chain Management Certificate
Certificate Program
Standard (in-person)
The certificate helps professionals keep pace with rapidly changing technology and business practices in supply chain and logistics. Jacksonville is a hub for some of the most dynamic and contemporary companies in the logistics and supply chain industry.
Learn More
College of Arts and Sciences
Biology (M.A., M.S.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The University of North Florida’s Master of Arts (M.A.) in Biology and a Master of Science (M.S.) in Biology offer students a rigorous and research-driven education designed to prepare them for careers in science, education, biotechnology, environmental management, and beyond. Whether pursuing a Master of Arts (M.A.) with a broader interdisciplinary focus or a Master of Science (M.S.) with an emphasis on research and technical expertise, students benefit from small class sizes, hands-on lab and field experiences, and close mentorship from dedicated faculty.
Learn More
Communication Management (M.S.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The Master of Science in Communication Management at the University of North Florida prepares students to lead and innovate in today’s fast-evolving communication landscape. Designed for professionals seeking to advance their careers, this program emphasizes strategic communication, leadership, and digital media skills essential for success in corporate, nonprofit, government, and media sectors.
Learn More
Criminal Justice (MSCJ)
Master's Degree
Primarily Online
The Master of Science in Criminal Justice (M.S.C.J.) at the University of North Florida prepares students for advanced careers in law enforcement, corrections, homeland security, and criminal justice policy. Designed for professionals and recent graduates alike, the program offers a comprehensive curriculum that focuses on contemporary issues, research methods, and leadership skills essential for navigating today’s complex justice system.
Learn More
English (M.A.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The Master of Arts in English at the University of North Florida invites students to deepen their engagement with language, literature, and critical thought. Designed for those passionate about reading, writing, and analysis, the program offers a flexible and intellectually rich environment that prepares graduates for a diverse range of careers in education, writing, publishing, and advanced graduate studies.
Learn More
History (M.A.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The Master of Arts in History at the University of North Florida offers students a rigorous and enriching exploration of past events, cultures, and ideas that have shaped our world. Designed for both recent graduates and working professionals, the program emphasizes critical thinking, research skills, and historical analysis across different periods and regions.
Learn More
Mathematical Sciences (M.S.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The Master of Science in Mathematical Sciences at the University of North Florida offers a dynamic and rigorous program designed to deepen your understanding of advanced mathematical theories and applications. Whether you’re preparing for a career in industry, education, or further graduate study, this program equips students with critical problem-solving skills and analytical techniques essential in today’s data-driven world.
Learn More
Music (M.M.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The Master of Music (M.M.) program at the University of North Florida is designed to cultivate advanced musical skills and artistic expression across a variety of disciplines. Whether you aim to excel as a performer, educator, or scholar, the program offers rigorous training combined with personalized mentorship from accomplished faculty.
Learn More
Music Education (MME)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The Master of Music Education (M.M.E.) program at the University of North Florida is designed for music educators who want to deepen their pedagogical knowledge, refine their musical skills, and advance their careers. Whether you’re currently teaching or preparing to enter the profession, the M.M.E. offers a dynamic blend of research, musicianship, and practical application tailored to today’s educational environments. This program is no longer accepting applicants effective Fall 2026.
Learn More
Psychological Science (M.S.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The Master of Science in Psychological Science at the University of North Florida is a research-centered graduate program designed for students seeking advanced training in psychological theory, empirical methods, and data analysis. Ideal for those preparing for doctoral study or research-focused careers, the program emphasizes hands-on experience, faculty mentorship, and scientific inquiry across diverse areas of psychology.
Learn More
Public Administration (MPA)
Master's Degree
Hybrid
The Master of Public Administration (MPA) at the University of North Florida prepares students to lead and manage in government, nonprofit, and public service organizations. Designed for both emerging professionals and experienced practitioners, the program equips students with essential skills in policy analysis, budgeting, organizational leadership, and ethical governance.
Learn More
Social Work (M.S.W.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The Master of Social Work (M.S.W.) program at the University of North Florida prepares students to become compassionate, skilled, and ethical social work professionals equipped to serve individuals, families, and communities. Grounded in a commitment to social justice, equity, and evidence-based practice, the program offers a strong foundation for both clinical and community-based careers.
Learn More
Applied Mathematics Certificate
Certificate Program
Standard (in-person)
As a student in the Applied Mathematics Certificate program, you can increase your understanding of mathematical models while you train on industry-standard software packages such as Maple, Matlab, and Mathematica.
Learn More
Digital Humanities Certificate
Certificate Program
Standard (in-person)
The use of digital tools in higher education and in community-based research projects has experienced significant growth in the last few years.
Learn More
Non-Profit Management Certificate
Certificate Program
Standard (in-person)
The Graduate Certificate Program in Nonprofit Management at the University of North Florida is intended to equip members or aspiring members of the nonprofit community in the northeast Florida region with relevant professional administrative and managerial skills.
Learn More
Public History Certificate
Certificate Program
Standard (in-person)
The Post-Baccalaureate Certificate in Public History is composed of 4 courses and consists of 12 credit hours. This certificate offers advanced training for students interested in pursuing a career in public history and those already working in the field.
Learn More
College of Computing, Engineering and Construction
Computing (Ph.D.)
Doctoral Degree
Standard (in-person)
The Ph.D. in Computing at the University of North Florida is a research-intensive program designed to develop scholars, innovators, and thought leaders in advanced computing disciplines. With a focus on interdisciplinary inquiry and real-world impact, the program prepares students to conduct original research in areas such as artificial intelligence, data science, cybersecurity, human-centered computing, and software engineering.
Learn More
Civil Engineering (M.S.C.E.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The Master of Science in Civil Engineering (M.S.C.E.) at the University of North Florida is designed for students seeking to advance their expertise in designing, building, and maintaining the infrastructure that shapes our communities. Whether pursuing a career in industry, research, or further academic study, this program offers the knowledge and hands-on experience needed to meet today’s engineering challenges and innovate for the future.
Learn More
Computer and Information Sciences (M.S.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The Master of Science in Computer and Information Sciences at the University of North Florida equips students with advanced knowledge and practical skills in computing, preparing them to thrive in today’s fast-paced tech landscape. Whether pursuing careers in software development, cybersecurity, data analytics, or artificial intelligence, students gain a strong foundation in theory, research, and application.
Learn More
Construction Management (M.S.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The Master of Science in Construction Management at the University of North Florida prepares students to lead complex construction projects with confidence, precision, and professionalism. Designed for both early-career professionals and industry veterans, the program blends technical knowledge with advanced leadership, project management, and sustainability practices.
Learn More
Electrical Engineering (M.S.E.E.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The Master of Science in Electrical Engineering (M.S.E.E.) at the University of North Florida is designed for students seeking to deepen their knowledge of electrical and computer engineering while advancing their careers in a rapidly evolving, technology-driven world. Whether pursuing professional growth, research opportunities, or preparation for doctoral study, the program offers a strong foundation in areas such as embedded systems, signal processing, power systems, and communications.
Learn More
Mechanical Engineering (M.S.M.E.)
Master's Degree
Standard (in-person)
The Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering (M.S.M.E.) at the University of North Florida provides students with advanced knowledge and research experience in the design, analysis, and optimization of mechanical systems. Offered through the College of Computing, Engineering, and Construction, the program is ideal for students seeking to deepen their expertise, pursue research opportunities, or prepare for doctoral study and leadership roles in industry.
Learn More
Silverfield College of Education and Human Services
Curriculum and Instruction (Ed.D.)
Doctoral Degree
Hybrid
The University of North Florida’s Doctor of Education (Ed.D.) in Curriculum and Instruction is designed for experienced educators and professionals who are passionate about shaping the future of teaching, learning, and educational leadership. Grounded in equity, innovation, and scholarly inquiry, our program prepares students to become transformative leaders in schools, districts, higher education, and educational organizations.
Learn More
Educational Leadership (Ed.D.)
Doctoral Degree
Hybrid
The University of North Florida’s Doctor of Education (Ed.D.) in Educational Leadership is designed for professionals committed to leading meaningful change in schools, districts, higher education institutions, and educational organizations. This advanced program equips aspiring and current leaders with the knowledge, skills, and vision to navigate complex educational landscapes, drive equity-focused reforms, and inspire collaborative, data-informed decision-making.
Learn More
Exceptional Student Education (M.A.T.)
Master's Degree
Fully Online
The University of North Florida’s M.A.T. in Exceptional Student Education prepares passionate educators to meet the various needs of students with disabilities and exceptionalities. This program equips you with the knowledge, skills, and practical experience to create inclusive, supportive learning environments where all students can thrive.
Learn More
American Sign Language and English Interpreting (M.S.)
Master's Degree
Fully Online
The Master of Science in American Sign Language and English Interpreting at the University of North Florida is designed for individuals seeking to advance their skills and knowledge as professional interpreters. Grounded in a commitment to linguistic and cultural competence, the program prepares students to work effectively in diverse settings where ASL and English interpretation are essential.
Learn More
Counselor Education in School Counseling (M.Ed.)
Master's Degree
Hybrid
